reading.body:
Involta Independence sits in Cuyahoga County near Cleveland, Ohio. The facility is designed to Tier III standards and claims 100 percent power delivery availability, qualifications suitable for continuous production workloads. The operator's own site lists this as one of ten enterprise-class data centers but publishes no power or capacity figure for this specific campus. Without published specifications, its scale relative to other Ohio facilities cannot be determined from operator disclosures.

Ohio has 76 mapped data center facilities, of which only eight have published power capacity. The state's total published capacity is 60.4 megawatts across those eight facilities. Involta Independence does not appear in that published subset, placing it outside the ranked facilities with disclosed power figures. The absence of a megawatt specification means this campus may operate at any scale from marginal to substantial, and cannot be assessed against peers.

For a reader evaluating whether this campus matters to AI scaling, the missing power figure is the binding constraint. Involta Independence holds a certification for production reliability and an operator presence in the market, but without knowing its IT load capacity, whether in megawatts, racks, or accelerators, its relevance to AI infrastructure cannot be read from published sources.
